scope: Shared adaptive foreground correction, visible material sampling, configurable grouping, and smooth glyph transitions.

Compare all first-install widget files with the approved candidate, test repeat staging, verify the same shaped-glyph coordinates before and after caching, and run both launcher presets and the Control Center X11 render probe.
